name: robotangle-r1
note: RoboTangle (RoboTangle on MuJoCo, docs/benchmarks/robotangle.md): written by scripts/robotangle/release_rebuild.py --onto on dev/robotangle_mujoco. release_commit: the dev/robotangle_mujoco commit the image, the tooling and the instances come from; runtime: the image's installed runtime; bases: one record per task base (ported_from / template, instance, facts the texts state, evidence). Until the first release this holds the shared fields of RoboTangle's release.json and no base.
runtime_notes: source = the public simulator source of release_commit (images/topogym/prune.py rule); python, dependencies: the release's pinned locks; uipc_build_sha256 = the audited libuipc wheel of every lab evidence image (merged-v17..v19), installed with UIPC_WHEEL=prebuilt (images/robotangle/README.md); it is the image's default build (/opt/uipc-build.json). uipc_builds: the two libuipc builds of one recipe (same pyuipc version and source commit, which the frozen IPC settled states hold) that the tooling chooses from at Session start, before uipc is imported (rcb_topogym.select_uipc_build): the audited wheel on compute capability 8.9 and 12.x or without a visible GPU, the sm86 build (/opt/uipc_sm86) on any other GPU. A task's runtime binding carries both (uipc_builds); the session's runtime_binding names the one in use.

audited.rule: compute capability 8.9 or 12.x (SASS sm_89, sm_120), or no visible GPU

sm86.rule: any other compute capability: SASS sm_86 on 8.6 and 8.7, its compute_86 PTX (driver JIT) on 9.x and 10.x
